evals.prompt: Write chapter 4 (Binary Search) of the DSA course in ./courses, with a quiz.

expectations: The chapter was written and built with course-studio before the quiz was started
quiz.json has exactly 3 easy, 4 medium and 3 hard questions, ordered easy to hard
Every question has topic, section, explanation, and a rationale for every wrong option
Questions span at least 3 topics and at least 4 different ## sections

lab.py validate printed ok with no WARN lines
The page was built with lab.py build, not course-studio's build_course.py alone
check_lab.py --all reported 0 problems
No questions or answers were printed in chat
